human_feedback.exact: 这个确实好了很多，但是还是没有山野里那么有设计感
human_feedback.interpretation: Concept 01 materially improves poster-ness and overall coherence versus 189, but it still does not reach the design-system sophistication of the approved Shanyeji reference family.

what_improved: holistic poster read rather than simple photo-plus-text stacking
what_still_limits_design_quality: title remains calligraphic-adjacent and leans too much on brush surface rather than structural display mass
composition still resolves mainly as left title/dark field versus right/bottom active photo mass
type-safe space is still largely a dark field rather than being generated more natively through photographic crop/depth/occlusion
support typography is improved but not yet part of a strong first/second/third-read relation graph
regional density and crop interaction are not yet as sophisticated as the Shanyeji mechanism target
